name: Matching Brackets
blurb: Make sure the brackets and braces all match.
instructions:
# Instructions

Given a string containing brackets `[]`, braces `{}`, parentheses `()`, or any combination thereof, verify that any and all pairs are matched and nested correctly.
Any other characters should be ignored.
For example, `"{what is (42)}?"` is balanced and `"[text}"` is not.
introduction:
# Introduction

You're given the opportunity to write software for the Bracketeer™, an ancient but powerful mainframe.
The software that runs on it is written in a proprietary language.
Much of its syntax is familiar, but you notice _lots_ of brackets, braces and parentheses.
Despite the Bracketeer™ being powerful, it lacks flexibility.
If the source code has any unbalanced brackets, braces or parentheses, the Bracketeer™ crashes and must be rebooted.
To avoid such a scenario, you start writing code that can verify that brackets, braces, and parentheses are balanced before attempting to run it on the Bracketeer™.
starter_code:
# Determine if a string has matching (balanced) brackets.
# Result | String
IsPaired ← |1 ⊙(⍤ "Please implement IsPaired" 0)
test_code:
~ "matching-brackets.ua" ~ IsPaired

# paired square brackets
⍤⤙≍ 1 IsPaired "[]"

# empty string
⍤⤙≍ 1 IsPaired ""

# unpaired brackets
⍤⤙≍ 0 IsPaired "[["

# wrong ordered brackets
⍤⤙≍ 0 IsPaired "}{"

# wrong closing bracket
⍤⤙≍ 0 IsPaired "{]"

# paired with whitespace
⍤⤙≍ 1 IsPaired "{ }"

# partially paired brackets
⍤⤙≍ 0 IsPaired "{[])"

# simple nested brackets
⍤⤙≍ 1 IsPaired "{[]}"

# several paired brackets
⍤⤙≍ 1 IsPaired "{}[]"

# paired and nested brackets
⍤⤙≍ 1 IsPaired "([{}({}[])])"

# unopened closing brackets
⍤⤙≍ 0 IsPaired "{[)][]}"

# unpaired and nested brackets
⍤⤙≍ 0 IsPaired "([{])"

# paired and wrong nested brackets
⍤⤙≍ 0 IsPaired "[({]})"

# paired and wrong nested brackets but innermost are correct
⍤⤙≍ 0 IsPaired "[({}])"

# paired and incomplete brackets
⍤⤙≍ 0 IsPaired "{}["

# too many closing brackets
⍤⤙≍ 0 IsPaired "[]]"

# early unexpected brackets
⍤⤙≍ 0 IsPaired ")()"

# early mismatched brackets
⍤⤙≍ 0 IsPaired "{)()"

# math expression
⍤⤙≍ 1 IsPaired "(((185 + 223.85) * 15) - 543)/2"

# complex latex expression
⍤⤙≍ 1 IsPaired "\\left(\\begin{array}{cc} \\frac{1}{3} & x\\\\ \\mathrm{e}^{x} &... x^2 \\end{array}\\right)"
